# hpe_morpheus_monitoring_alert (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Monitoring Alert resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_monitoring_alert" "example" {
  name         = "High Severity Alert"
  min_severity = "critical"
  min_duration = 5
  active       = true
  all_checks   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the monitoring alert.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the alert is active.
- `all_checks` (Boolean) Trigger for all checks.
- `all_groups` (Boolean) Trigger for all check groups.
- `min_duration` (Number) Duration in minutes of the delay before sending notifications.
- `min_severity` (String) Severity level threshold for sending notifications.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the monitoring alert.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_monitoring_alert.example 123
```
